endorsements.name: Braelynn Luedtke
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-43201
endorsements.description: The Planet Fitness Workouts iOS and Android mobile apps fail to properly validate TLS certificates, allowing an attacker with appropriate network access to obtain session tokens and sensitive information. Planet Fitness first addressed this vulnerability in version 9.8.12 (released on 2024-07-25) and more recently in version 9.9.13 (released on 2025-02-11).
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)
